# MedGlobalNetwork (MGN)

> MedGlobalNetwork (https://mgn.life) is the premier verified global social, clinical collaboration, and Continuing Medical Education (CME) ecosystem built exclusively for healthcare professionals including medical doctors (MD/MBBS), surgeons, physical therapists, nurses, and clinical researchers.

## Core Platform Modules

- [MedGlobalNetwork Home](https://mgn.life): Official platform landing page, mission, clinician directory, and ecosystem overview.
- [Healthcare Professional Network](https://mgn.life/network): Peer-to-peer clinical case discussions, medical specialty groups, and colleague connections.
- [Medical Communities](https://mgn.life/network/communities): Specialized medical societies and clinical focus groups (Cardiology, Orthopedics, Neurology, Physiotherapy, Oncology, etc.).
- [Continuing Medical Education (CME)](https://mgn.life/learn): Accredited medical courses, video masterclasses, interactive quiz banks, and clinical mind maps.
- [Course Catalog](https://mgn.life/learn/courses): Searchable repository of CME-accredited courses, surgical procedures, and clinical workshops.
- [Medical Conferences & Events](https://mgn.life/events): Virtual webinars, hybrid conferences, surgical workshops, and clinical symposia with registration and attendance tracking.
- [Community Health Camps](https://mgn.life/camps): Free health screening camps, rural medical outreach, and physiotherapy rehabilitation drives with volunteer clinician management.
- [Healthcare Careers & Jobs](https://mgn.life/opportunities/jobs): Verified hospital positions, clinical fellowships, medical residency openings, and healthcare consulting roles.
- [Medical Research & Publications](https://mgn.life/research): Clinical trial collaborations, multi-center research initiatives, preprints, and case reports.
- [Pricing & Subscriptions](https://mgn.life/pricing): Membership tiers for individual doctors, clinics, and hospital networks.
- [Creation Center](https://mgn.life/create): Unified publishing hub for clinical posts, CME courses, medical events, health camps, and job requisitions.

## Medical Credential Verification & Trust

MGN enforces a strict verification process for all healthcare practitioners. Clinicians provide:
1. Official National/State Medical Council Registration Number
2. Medical License and Practicing Certificates
3. Institutional or Hospital Affiliation Documentation

Verified clinicians receive the verified badge, unlocking clinical discussions, peer messaging, and course accreditation.

## Key Medical Specialties Supported

- Cardiology & Cardiovascular Surgery
- Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation
- Neurology & Neurosurgery
- Physical Therapy & Sports Rehabilitation
- General Medicine & Primary Care
- Pediatrics & Neonatology
- Oncology & Hematology
- Dermatology & Aesthetic Medicine
- Anesthesiology & Critical Care
- Radiology & Diagnostic Imaging
